title: spiesia physocarpa
intro: Spiesia physocarpa, commonly known as Desert Marigold, is a plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is valued for its bright yellow or orange flowers, which bloom in the winter and early spring. The plant is known for its health benefits, including its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and boost the immune system. Spiesia physocarpa contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
